claim_wording.text: Two routes to the same channel repair: the lineage Right under its training condition, and hired lowland labour credited against the draw. Together they could take the repair off the households' rota, though the second route holds only under condition B (inferred).

result.reasoning: Route one rests on E1, which states that lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right and that households on the rota carry the rest. The training condition is not stated in the cited items. Route two rests only on E5, an agent_proposed offer that is neither accepted nor refused. E24 and E2 support the inferred dependency on condition B. E24 names grain-labour, not hired labour, so crediting hired labour against the draw is an inference.
result.quote: The offer is neither accepted nor refused, because the Compact's settlement is author-reserved.
result.alternative_reading: The offered quote carries the offer and its conditional terms but not its status: E5 is agent_proposed and says the offer is neither accepted nor refused. The training condition the wording names is not stated in the cited items.
result.would_settle: The author's ruling on the Compact's settlement, and a cited record stating the training condition and what condition B requires.
result.creative_room: Possible: hired lowland labour credited against the Compact's draw could take part of the repair off the households' rota alongside the lineage Right, under condition B. Interference points: the Compact's author-reserved settlement and the Book 27 to 29 bid. Proposals, not record: the Oona Brisk offer and its terms, the training condition, and the content of condition B.
